headline: US dollar weakens as Fed-fueled rally stalls and Treasury yields ease
summary: The US dollar index fell 0.2% to 103.75 on Friday as a multi-week rally driven by expectations of a hawkish Federal Reserve lost momentum. Lower US Treasury bond yields provided support to the Japanese yen.
why: The US dollar index is the premier standard for foreign exchange sentiment, impacting sovereign debt servicing costs and global trade flows.

impacts.name: US Dollar Index
impacts.why: Easing Treasury yields reduced interest rate differentials favoring the dollar against major currencies.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Declining Treasury yields halted a multi-week dollar advance as rate hike expectations receded.
